contract.semantics: Existing n=2+3*smoothing superellipse; radius clamp/index order and smoothing<1e-6 circular branch unchanged. Not Figma corner-smoothing parity. Supported authoring range remains0..1; no blanket clamp of previously admitted finite>1 values.

contract.precision: Visible CPU fill keeps caller tolerance (analytic1/64 internal px; compatible1/8192 internal px), including internal2x scale. Convex subarc tangent triangle distance to finite chord segment bounds error; near-parallel tangents use monotone box. Exact cardinal points; normal values and endpoints reused to avoid repeated pow.
contract.guard: Only CPU fill may replace a subarc wholly beyond one effect-expanded guard half-plane with its chord. Transformed monotone endpoint box encloses both; winding inside guard is unchanged. Guard includes existing scene/effect/backdrop halo and absolute tile coordinates. No persistent cache. Complete bounds/picking/stroke expansion/edit geometry remain unclipped.
